text:
lauren: Quick sync on the Peregrine pilot — cutover window Thu 9am PT. Need owners for: firewall/network CIDR, model variant & quantization, and final success criteria. Anyone owning one of these?

raj: I can take the firewall change. Will open a CR and coordinate with eng-infra.

dena: I’ll own model variant. Proposal: use rdx-open-13b-8q for cost parity, run perf on dedicated pool tomorrow.

chris: PR #5234 (runtime routing & batching) is ready for review — https://github.com/redwood/realtime/pull/5234
chris: pinging @lauren for final OK on fallback policy in that PR. small change in routing table affects experiment.

lauren: thanks — @raj please include the public IPs we need to authorize for Peregrine app (they asked for a CIDR). Also @dena share a perf run by EOD so sales has numbers for the call.

raj: noted. draft CR: "Allow Peregrine POC egress from 10.48.32.0/24 to redwood-dedicated-gw"
raj: sample gcloud snippet I’ll add to CR:```gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-peregrine --network=prod-vpc --source-ranges=10.48.32.0/24 --direction=EGRESS --action=ALLOW --rules=tcp:443 --target-tags=redwood-dedicated```

dena: running batch tests with batch_size=[1,4,8], kv cache warmups. Early numbers: p50 token latency ~220ms at batch=1 on rdx-13b-8q, cost ~35% lower vs rdx-13b-16q. Will post full CSV.

amy: for Sales we need clear success criteria by tomorrow: 1) 95% requests <= 350ms p50, 2) end-to-end ingest+response < 750ms for sample payloads, 3) embeddings within expected vector dim & latency < 150ms. Can we lock these?

lauren: agree. @dena confirm if (1) is achievable with suggested quantization; if not, call out fallback to rdx-13b-16q. @chris confirm PR routing won't add >50ms overhead.

chris: PR adds ~20ms in our bench. routing is optional fallback, so we can keep primary path low-latency.

raj: CR opened: https://cr.redwood.internal/CR-1987 — added the gcloud snippet, staging window Thu 6am-8am PT, prod cutover Thu 9am PT. tagging @eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging deploy Thu 06:10 PT -> job 8872. Notify #eng-oncall if failures.

lauren: Ok team — timeline: dena posts perf CSV by EOD, chris resolves one comment in PR, raj merges CR and runs staging change. I’ll update the Peregrine success checklist for Sales and confirm customer call after staging run. Thanks :white_check_mark:
